item.title: Challenger League Major III Is in the Books: Next Stop, the Grand Finals!
item.description: The final Major of the WTCS Challenger League regular season wrapped up last weekend, and the race for the top spots went right down to the wire. With Major III now complete, the Challenger field is officially set and all eyes turn to the Challenger League Grand Finals.
